comment: Screen and art sizes (ROADMAP M10). Every scene reads these; never hardcode a tile size. project.godot's viewport must match baseWidth x baseHeight (a test checks).
detailScaleNote: Hand-drawn overlay details (furniture, boards, status chips, unit shadows) were authored for 16 px tiles; offsets are multiplied by this.

dayTint.comment: M12b: the town's light per day part (multiplied over the map). Interiors use 'interior'.

ambient.comment: M12b: ambient particles in town by zone and time: leaves by day, fireflies at night.

upsideDown.comment: M20: the Upside-Down screen shader (dungeon floors). layer sits under the UI layers.
